graphite.$description: Выбранная палитра (ADR-0004): нейтральный графит с голубым акцентом, по тёмным темам ChatGPT и Claude. Поверхности и текст — серые без цветового оттенка (авторские значения). Акцент и кольцо фокуса — официальный nord8, ошибка — подогнанный nord11 (оба из Nord, nordtheme.com). Подробности — design/tokens/palettes/README.md; в $extensions.kinige.origin каждой роли указано происхождение: «авторский», официальный цвет Nord или «подгонка» Nord.

background.$description: The background of the window and the sidebar around the feed: the darkest surface.

paper.$description: The feed 'paper': the background behind message plates and under the input field.

message.$description: The fill of a message plate and a toast: lighter than the paper (1.22:1).

code.$description: The background of a code block and inline code inside a plate: darker than the plate (1.27:1), like an 'inset'.

day.$description: The fill of the day label (a 'pill') in the center of the feed.

kinige.origin: авторский: то же значение, что surface.message

selected.$description: The selected chat in the sidebar, the selected settings tree item, the fill of a button and of hover on an icon (D2: was #2b2b2b). Lighter than the window background by 1.42:1 and lighter than hover by 1.21:1, so the selected item reads next to the one highlighted under the mouse.

hover.$description: The highlight of a row under the mouse (the sidebar, the settings tree): quiet, lighter than the window background by 1.17:1 and darker than the selected row (surface.selected is lighter than it by 1.21:1). The selected one is surface.selected, hover is this (D2).

card.$description: The fill of the 'On this day' card (slice 5) in the feed: lighter than the paper (1.22:1), with no border and no shadow. The feed 'paper' itself lies on surface.paper, so a card with the same fill would dissolve in it.

kinige.origin: авторский: то же значение, что surface.message

field.$description: The fill of an input field with no outline: the search, the composer.

kinige.origin: авторский: то же значение, что surface.message

field-active.$description: The fill of an input field when it has the cursor: slightly lighter (1.14:1 to the normal one). Together with the fill change, a focused field has a thin line in the focus color.

primary.$description: The primary entry text: almost white, neutral.

secondary.$description: Secondary text: captions, chat names, the day label.

tertiary.$description: Metadata: the time, hints, the entry counter, icons. A quiet gray, not an accent.

default.$description: A muted accent: links, a checked task, the 'Send' button, the cursor.

kinige.origin: nord8 (официально: основной акцентный цвет Frost, ссылки)

divider.$description: A thin divider: the border of the sidebar and the feed (decorative).

background.$description: The fill of a highlighted message (found by search, a jump by link): noticeably lighter than the plate (1.32:1; D2: was #3a3a3a) and lighter than the selected row (1.22:1). The time, the error and the accent on it stay at >= 4.6:1.

row.$description: The fill of a row selected with the arrows in the search results: the focus stays in the field, and this is the only sign of what Enter will open. Lighter than the plate by 1.52:1 (the threshold is 1.5). The primary text on it is 8.5:1, the secondary 6.9:1; the tertiary on it is below 4.5:1, so in the selected row it is replaced by the secondary.

mark.$description: The fill of a found word in the entry text (search, slice 4): a neutral gray, noticeably lighter than the plate (1.8:1) and the highlighted plate (1.5:1). The primary text on it is 7.0:1, the secondary 5.6:1. Tertiary text and the accent are not placed on it: words in links and tags are not highlighted.

ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring (buttons, rows, links) and a thin line in the input field.

error.$description: The 'not sent' state and errors (PRD §1.2 item 9).

kinige.origin: подгонка: nord11 (красный Aurora), HSL-светлота 56,5 % → 73,5 % при том же тоне и насыщенности

recording.$description: The dot of the recording bar (slice 7a): a saturated red that says "live", brighter than the error text color. Used as a shape, not as text: >= 3:1 on every surface (the UI threshold), 3.7:1 on the message plate.

unplayed.$description: The bars of a voice note's waveform that have not been played yet (slice 7a, acceptance round 3): a neutral gray, so the played part (accent.default) stands out by hue as well as by lightness, as in Telegram. It is the darkest neutral gray that still meets the project's 2.0:1 minimum for a graphic on the message plate (#585858 gives 1.99): the largest step from the accent that the rule allows, 3.5:1. On the highlighted plate (a short-lived jump target) it is 1.53:1, enough to stay visible. The earlier teal tries (#5b848f, #44626a) were 2.0:1 and 3.3:1 away from the accent and read as one color.

tile.$description: Letter tiles of chats without an emoji (D2): a rounded square with the first letter of the title in text.primary. Saturated but muted colors; the lightness of each is picked so that text.primary on it is at least 5:1 (the tests require 4.5:1). Every tile is at least 1.2:1 apart from the window background, the hover fill and the selected row.

grey.$description: Tile color "grey" (KINIG-59): neutral, chosen by hand only (the automatic colour never picks it) and fixed for Inbox. text.primary on it is 5.27:1; it is 3.21:1 from the window background, 2.74:1 from the hover fill and 2.27:1 from the selected row.

kinige.origin: авторский: нейтральный серый, тон 0°, насыщенность 0 %, светлота 40 %
